# Caelestinus Flagship "Archon"
[color=gray][italic]In the name of all those who could not defend themselves.[/italic][/color]
[bold]Flagship "Archon"[/bold] is an optional objective and exit plan for Caelestinus. "Archon" is an effective supercapital-class vessel intended to maintain Caelestinus' independence through overwhelming force.
## Requirements
- [bold]1,200,000 research points[/bold] are required in order to research the recipe for the LPC. The LPC itself then requires: - [bold]caelestinus flagship "Archon" activation chip ALPHA[/bold], held by Caelestinus' Overseer. - [bold]caelestinus flagship "Archon" activation chip OMEGA[/bold], acquired through [textlink="reverse engineering" link="Caelestinus_ReverseEngineering"]. - [bold]15 small monolithic crystals[/bold] found primarily on monolithic fragments and rarely in other locations. - A large amount of materials.
The materials are: - [bold]300 steel[/bold] - [bold]250 plasteel[/bold] - [bold]150 copper[/bold] - [bold]150 lithium[/bold] - [bold]50 glass[/bold] - [bold]50 plasma[/bold] - [bold]50 silver[/bold] - [bold]50 gold[/bold] - [bold]30 plastitanium[/bold] - [bold]30 depleted uranium[/bold] - [bold]10 fissile uranium[/bold]
## Armament
Flagship "Archon" is equipped with several superheavy ballistic cannons in order to swat off attackers from the sides as well as take down enemy shields.
It is also equipped with the experimental [color=red]CWZS-2048 "Retribution"[/color] laser cannon as a spinal mount.
"Retribution" fires a devastating beam capable of drilling into hulls for 30 seconds straight before going on cooldown for five minutes. However, it is harmless against a shielded ship.
